    m.addConstr(0.33 * vars['Var_3'] >= 0.18, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(9.33 * vars['Var_0'] + -1.39 * vars['Var_1'] + 1.72 * vars['Var_4'] >= 40.36, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(7.23 * vars['Var_2'] + 6.14 * vars['Var_4'] >= 26.62, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(4.49 * vars['Var_0'] + -4.48 * vars['Var_2'] + -1.93 * vars['Var_3'] + 0.77 * vars['Var_5'] >= 12.05, name='C6')

    m.optimize()
